## alice-dms-classification-backfill (PROJ-78)

One-time/repeatable manual backfill: reclassifies every existing document across all six
classifiable Weaviate collections using the same two-attempt classification logic as the
nightly alice-dms-processor (shared via the alice-dms-classify-document sub-workflow).

**Trigger**: POST /webhook/alice-dms-classification-backfill
**Dry-run** (no `confirm` param): reports deviations only, no writes.
**Confirm** (`confirm=true`): migrates every deviating document to its correct collection,
re-extracts with the target type's prompt, deletes the old object, regenerates its thumbnail,
and (for BankStatement in/out transitions) regenerates/orphan-deletes BankTransaction children.

**Locking**: shares the exact same Redis lock key as alice-dms-processor
(`alice:dms:processor:lock:run`) so the two never compete for the Ollama/TITAN X resource.
**Batching**: same wall-clock time-limit pattern as the nightly processor (7200s), resumable
across multiple invocations/nights — already-corrected documents simply stop showing up as
deviations on the next dry-run.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { mode: 'error', error: 'alice-dms-classification-backfill: lock busy — alice-dms-processor or another backfill run is currently active. Try again later.' } }];
